data.title: PM pledges fair EV incentives to retain investors
data.description: <p>Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has pledged to improve investment conditions for Japanese businesses and review electric vehicle (EV) incentives to ensure manufacturers from all countries are treated fairly, amid concerns over regional competition for automotive investment.</p>

data.title: Expelled student apologises for school shooting threat in Hat Yai
data.description: SONGKHLA - A 14-year-old former student has apologised after posting social media messages threatening to carry out a shooting at a school in Hat Yai district of this southern province, prompting a police investigation.

data.title: 44 Thais repatriated from Cambodia
data.description: Thai security authorities received 44 Thai nationals returning from Cambodia at the Ban Khlong Luek border checkpoint in Aranyaprathet district of Sa Kaeo province on Friday, with five wanted on arrest warrants.

data.title: Chiang Mai city buses returning to the roads
data.description: City buses will resume services in Chiang Mai this month, after soaring fuel prices forced the operator to pull the fleet off the streets for the first time in eight years.

data.title: Flooding persists in six provinces
data.description: Flooding continues to affect six provinces in Thailand, with more than 73,000 people impacted, while some areas have begun recovery efforts as water levels recede, according to the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation (DDPM).

data.title: 600 rai of illegal durian plantations to be cleared in Trat
data.description: TRAT - Authorities are preparing to clear more than 600 rai of illegal durian plantations around the Huai Raeng reservoir in Muang district of this eastern province as part of a crackdown on encroachment by investors.

data.title: Restaurant consoles customer who left ominous order note
data.description: A restaurant owner in Thailand has shared how a seemingly innocuous note left on a food delivery order prompted him and his partner to contact a customer, who was going through an emotional crisis and had intended the meal to be her last.

data.title: Two new plant species discovered in Tak national park
data.description: Two plant species previously unknown to science have been discovered in Khun Phawo National Park in Tak province, the Department of National Parks, Wildlife and Plant Conservation (DNP) said.

data.title: Govt urged to create task force
data.description: <p>The Pollution Control Department (PCD) is asking the Natural Resources and Environment Ministry to establish a task force to tackle industrial waste problems after finding that illegal waste disposal cases are linked across several provinces.</p>

data.title: Over 20 Taiwanese cuffed over links to scam network
data.description: <p>Thailand and Taiwan have arrested more than 20 Taiwanese suspects allegedly linked to a call-centre scam network operating in Cambodia, with investigators now trying to identify the financiers behind the operation.</p>

data.title: People's Party aiming for Nonthaburi PAO presidency
data.description: <p>The opposition People's Party (PP) has launched its campaign for the Nonthaburi Provincial Administrative Organisation (PAO) presidency, with candidate Decharut Sukkumnoed drawing ballot number 4 and urging residents to back him in the Sept 20 election.</p>

data.title: Thai government to review gun controls
data.description: <p>The government is preparing sweeping amendments to the country's gun control law, with the draft expected to reach the cabinet around mid-September after further public consultation, Deputy Prime Minister Pakorn Nilprapunt says.</p>

data.title: Klatham merger 'will help Pheu Thai'
data.description: <p>Political commentator Jatuporn Prompan has warned that a possible merger between Pheu Thai and the Klatham Party could reshape the political landscape, potentially making Pheu Thai the second-largest party and challenging Bhumjaithai's position as the largest.</p>

data.title: SRT subsidiary readies for ARL takeover
data.description: <p>The State Railway of Thailand (SRT) is preparing its subsidiary to take over the Airport Rail Link when the current operator's contract ends next month.</p>

data.title: House asked to look into AoT deals
data.description: <p>Former MP Charnchai Isarasenarak and former senator Adm Phajun Tamprateep have asked the House panel tasked with budget scrutiny to investigate an Airports of Thailand Plc (AoT) board resolution to amend airport duty-free and commercial concession contracts due to projected financial losses.</p>

data.title: Moei River overflows, prompting border market vendors in Mae Sot to move goods
data.description: Continuous heavy rain caused the Moei River in Mae Sot district of Tak province to overflow on Friday morning, forcing vendors at Rim Moei market to move their goods to higher ground.

data.description: <p>The government's TH-AI Passport project, which attracted about one million registrations within two days of its pre-launch, has raised questions about how personal data will be collected, stored and used.</p>
